issue_context.summary: Settings shows the mixed-language typo ‘zippped’ in Russian; the reporter expects a Russian sentence stating that log files will be packaged in a ZIP archive on the desktop. A maintainer has transferred the correction to the localization team under GSH ADO bug 1412151.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.98.0 and the Settings surface.
The reported current wording is the mixed-language typo ‘zippped’.
The reporter's requested wording or meaning is a Russian sentence stating that log files will be packaged in a ZIP archive on the desktop.
The issue is labeled Loc-Sent To Team and the maintainer linked GSH ADO bug 1412151.
inferences: The report is sufficiently specific for localization correction; additional reporter diagnostics would not change ownership or the requested wording.
Because the correction is in the localization team’s tracked workflow, a separate PowerToys code plan would duplicate active work.
The issue should remain open until a shipped localization drop is checked; the ADO link alone does not prove that the corrected string has shipped.
